nav.citizenPortalDesc: Search land, view maps, verify documents
nav.adminPortalDesc: Staff access, audit records, district stats

auth.signInSubtitle: Officers and admins sign in here for staff access. Citizens can browse and search the Citizen Portal with no account at all — sign in only if you want to see the parcels linked to your account.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong signing in. Please try again.
auth.demoAccountsPasswordNote: All demo accounts use the password
auth.registerComingSoon: Self-service registration isn't open yet. Sign in with one of the demo accounts below, or ask an administrator for a staff account.

hero.bodyP1: Checking your 7/12 extract, finding exact plot borders, or verifying ownership papers shouldn't take three trips to the Taluka office.
hero.bodyP2: BhoomiSetu links your registry papers, cadastral map lines, and revenue records in one simple dashboard. Search any plot across Pune and Maharashtra in seconds — free, open, and transparent.
hero.trustText: No login needed for parcel search, map boundaries, or registry verification.
hero.card1Desc: Enter your 14-digit Bhu-Aadhaar (ULPIN), Survey, or Gut number. Get owner names, land area, and soil records instantly.
hero.card2Desc: See real survey borders drawn over satellite pictures. Spot approach roads, neighbor borders, and water bodies clearly.
hero.card3Desc: Upload a photo of your 7/12 extract or Sale Deed. We compare names, stamps, and survey numbers directly against official books.
hero.card4Desc: Review land mutation files, inspect satellite change detection for encroachment, and clear pending citizen requests.

citizen.searchDesc: Type your 14-digit Bhu-Aadhaar, survey number, or plot number to pull up ownership and mutation status.
citizen.mapDesc: Click directly on any plot outline on the map to see boundary coordinates, area in hectares, and road connectivity.
citizen.verifyDesc: Upload a clear photo or PDF of your registered sale deed or 7/12 extract. We check if the owner names and plot numbers match government records.

admin.workflowOversightDesc: An Admin can already act on any department's workflow step — the backend allows it — but this dashboard doesn't have a review screen for it yet.
admin.mapLayerAuthoringDesc: Zoning, restriction, and infrastructure map layers already have working create/edit/delete APIs — there's no admin screen to drive them yet.

serviceRequest.signInRequiredBody: Filing a request needs a citizen account, so we can keep you updated on its status.

placeholders.landClaimDesc: Already found your plot in the records? Soon you'll be able to formally claim it and link it to your account for faster access next time.
placeholders.myRequestsDesc: A single dashboard rolling up every service request you've filed across all your parcels is on its way. Until then, check request status from each parcel's own 360 view.
placeholders.profileDesc: Manage your phone number, address, and account details — coming soon.
